message.content:
An olive green rectangular field serves as the backdrop for this editorial illustration. At the top, a large red sans-serif word "TEMPO" is centered, above which is a line of white text: "KALEIDOSKOP: Peristiwa Penting dan Genting Tahun Ini H.82". Below the main title is the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" in small red letters. Three silhouettes of assault rifles are positioned on the left, angled towards the center. The top rifle points downward and right, the middle rifle is horizontal, and the bottom rifle points upward and right. Each rifle has a dark, textured camouflage pattern. A small, white pixelated cursor icon shaped like a pointing hand is positioned at the far right of the middle rifle’s barrel.

On the upper right, a white star sits next to the text "TOKOH TEMPO 2025," followed by the bold white title "Mereka yang Masih Melawan." At the bottom, several lines of white text include the dates "29 DESEMBER 2025-4 JANUARI 2026," the price "RP 60.000," and "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN". A barcode and a QR code are located at the bottom right corner.
